assignment_title: Dessert Shop 2 — Using Classes in main
requirements:
Dessert Shop 2 — add an Order class and a main() driver.

Module `dessert` must contain: DessertItem, Candy, Cookie, IceCream, Sundae, and Order.
The Order class has:
  - attribute `order`: a list of DessertItem objects
  - a constructor taking no arguments other than self, creating an empty order
  - add(item): appends a DessertItem to the order list
  - __len__(): returns the number of items
  - __iter__() / __next__(): supports iteration over the order

Module `dessertshop` must contain main(), which creates an Order, adds the six
required items, prints the name of each DessertItem, then prints
"Total number of items in order: 6".

Dessert Shop 2 must include all code from Dessert Shop 1.
